पौत्र a. (त्री f.) [पृत्रस्यापत्यं अण्]
1
Relating to or derived from a son.
--त्रः A grandson, son's son.
--त्री {1} A
grand-daughter.
--2 An epithet of
Durgā.
--त्रं The office of a Potṛ, q. v.

पौत्रिक a. (की f.) Belonging to a
son or grandson.

पौत्रिकेयः The son of a daughter
appointed to raise issue for her
father.
